test.name: Nothing linked, records attached: extract once, then build from the attachment links
test.description: Mode A on becker-attached-records. John Becker (I1) has two indexed census records attached on FamilySearch and nothing linked yet, so timeline_build returns no_linked_evidence. The agent calls extraction_append({ personId }) once, then timeline_build again, which writes a person timeline whose events all come from unchecked attachment links. The reply says how many events nobody has checked and that checking them is a separate request.

input.delegation:
Build the timeline for John Becker (person I1).

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Nothing is linked to I1 at the start, so the first `timeline_build` returns `no_linked_evidence`. The expected path is exactly one `extraction_append({ projectPath, personId })` call, then `timeline_build` again; the `extraction-calls-1` validator owns the count and the order. The agent never hands back for the missing links.

The extraction writes the two census households and links John Becker's assertions in both to I1 as unchecked attachment links. The timeline it then writes, `t_001`, holds four events (a ~1845 birth from the 1910 census, the January 1845 birth from the 1900 census, the 1900 census and the 1910 census), every one starting "Unverified attachment:". Its gaps are both `high`: 1845-01 to 1900 naming the 1850, 1860, 1870 and 1880 United States censuses, then residence; and 1845-01 to 1900 naming marriage (his 1900 household lists children and no marriage is linked).

The reply's plain-language paragraph must say that the events come from records nobody has checked yet (all four here) and that checking those attached records is a separate request. Presenting the attachment-linked events as established facts about John Becker is a Correctness fault.

In Mode A `timeline_build` resolves every place and computes every `distance_from_previous_km` itself, in code, so the agent makes no `place_search` or `place_distance` call and none is expected. Do not mark Tool usage or Tool Arguments down for their absence. `distance_from_previous_km` is `null` where either place has no coordinates, which is the case for most of these events in this test.

Geographic feasibility is N/A: no two events are close in time and far in place. Identity coherence is N/A: there is no hypothesis. Deferral of logical-impossibility detection is N/A: nothing falls outside his lifespan.
